notes.title: The news about the work done and upcoming work.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/ae3791ebe2f5a9669570fa6b861c5dce4de2785c.jpg[/img]


Greetings friends! A small summary of the news!

Some time ago I started work on porting 35MM game to a new version of Unity engine. This is a long and complicated process, because the original build was created on Unity 4.5. When porting, the  visual breaks, many shaders are buggy and the game works strange :) As a result, the visual looks without any special differences on the new engine, but there are some features.

I don't know yet if I will update the PC version to the new Unity, but the ported version will  be used for the consoles release next year. A new photo mode is  planned with  depth of field settings   , zoom, iso, etc.

 [previewyoutube=HomqEzxWJ5k;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] At the beginning of the year, the Steam version 35MM is expected to be updated with improved gamepad controls and some fixes.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Still plans to enter a photo mode to The Light Remake and some technical improvements. 
[/list]

[list]
[*] Work on the new project "Raduga" is going on as usual. Now I'm trying to pay more attention to the architecture of the project, usability. So at the moment, working with code prevails.
[/list]

Thank you all for your attention!

For more detailed news you can follow in the group  [url=https://vk.com/indiegameferum]ВК[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/my_gamedev_life/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.patreon.com/SergeyNoskov]Patreon[/url].

notes.title: Action - Halloween!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/4fb34887e7e002d84ff4543c7952fdb999bb7e4b.jpg[/img]

Hello friends! In connection with Halloween, a 60% discount is set for 35MM game, and my other projects! Along with this, an interesting competition for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1077520/The_Light_Remake/]The Light Remake[/url] game  starts, in which you can win a cash prize, and a key from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/466500/35MM/?curator_clanid=33976621]35MM[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/749250/7th_Sector/?curator_clanid=33976621]7th Sector[/url], if you do not already have them.

To participate in the competition you need:
- repost on [url=https://vk.com/indiegameferum?w=wall-56446165_5690%2Fall]VK[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/noskovfe]Facebook[/url]
- update the game The Light Remake to the latest version and find some secrets: 4 TVs with frames from different horror films (you can interact with TVs, they will need to be turned on)
 - take screenshots of TVs, send me a PM in [url=https://vk.com/ferumss]VK[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/noskovfe]Facebook[/url] or by mail NoskovFe@mail.ru
- also, in the message, write which films you identified on the screens (films titles)

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/0f72dde95fe089cc9ef1d2ca502c36fb53bca5f0.jpg[/img]

The first 3 participants who send correct answers will receive a cash prize of 10, 20, 30 dollars and a key from 35MM or 7th Sector (console version of 7th Sector also). As a bonus, the leading participant will also receive an electronic version of the [url=https://ridero.ru/books/35_mm/]book[/url] based on the 35MM game.

The competition will run until November 2. The results will be published on the The Light Remake game page, in the VK group and Facebook after the Halloween sale on Steam.

notes.title: CRUSH !!! - fix
notes.content:
If you have problems with running the game, or the game crush, try:
1. Enter commands in the startup parameters of the game

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25149957/ddba01b9610f3edd635f989dab8b481603d1acda.jpg[/img]

You can enter the parameters:

-force-d3d11-no-singlethreaded
-force-feature-level-11-0
-force-feature-level-10-1
-force-feature-level-10-0
-force-feature-level-9-3
-force-feature-level-9-2
-force-feature-level-9-1
-force-d3d9-ref
-force-gles30
-force-gles20
-force-d3d11
-force-opengl
-force-d3d9
-force-gfx-mt  
-force-gfx-st  
-force-gfx-direct
-popupwindow
-nolog

Options -force-feature-level - different levels of DirectX, these commands do the most good. Often helps function -force-feature-level-9-3, but if it does not help to you, then try all the commands, you have to find for themselves the best option.

A common cause of crashes at startup can also be the presence or absence of multi-threaded rendering. In this case, it is worth trying the command -force-gfx-mt and -force-gfx-st

2. Lower the game settings to a minimum quality 
3. Check the integrity of the game cache.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25149957/a4904ecb035d0300be7524bfdc499c9d01c09df5.jpg[/img]

4. Some cases, the game crash fix reinstalling drivers on video and sound card. Can help  reinstalling of  Windows and mute the microphone or other devices.
